# WeeklyGridPage

Shows × days for one week: plays and new tracks per cell, today's column marked in --now, totals per day and per show, and one list per day on phones.

`SongNodes.WeeklyGridPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.WeeklyGridPage weekOf="…" rows={…} today="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.WeeklyGridPage" week-of="…" rows="{{…}}" today="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (WeeklyGridPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `weekOf` * | `string` | Monday of the week (weeks start Monday). |
| `rows` * | `{ show: string; slot: string; days: WeekCell[] }[]` | Rows: shows with Mon–Sun cells (index 0 = Monday). Future days render "Not yet". |
| `today` * | `string` | Today, for the --now column. |
| `onWeekChange` * | `(weekOf: IsoDate) => void` | Week navigation. |
| `state` * | `"loading" \| "ready" \| "refreshing" \| "empty" \| "error" \| "offline"` | Data state. |

### WeekCell

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plays` * | `number \| null` | Plays that day, or null when the show had no episode. |
| `newTracks` * | `number` | Of those, tracks new to the crate. |
